# Pembrook Apparel

> > Pembrook is a premium apparel company specializing in compression socks, diabetic socks, and therapeutic hosiery with over 45 years of ethical manufacturing excellence.

Founded in 1976, Pembrook Apparel is dedicated to providing high-quality compression and diabetic socks designed for comfort, circulation support, and foot health. The company manufactures ethically and offers a wide range of products including bamboo viscose socks, neuropathy relief socks, and medical-grade compression hosiery for both men and women.

## Key Topics

- Compression Socks
- Diabetic Socks
- Bamboo Viscose
- Neuropathy Relief
- Light Compression (8-15 mmHg)
- Moisture-Wicking
- Medical Hosiery
- Seamless Design
- Non-Binding
- Circulation Support
- Swollen Feet Relief
- Ethical Manufacturing
- Pembrook Heritage (1976)
- Dayton, Ohio
- Bestselling Products
